description: Hand-labelled edge cases for tuning the prompt and choosing a model. expect: "label" = must be labelled within the acceptable values; "none" = must be left blank; "either" = blank is fine, but any label must be within the acceptable values. An empty leanings list on a label/either item means the political leaning must be null.
labelledBy: Drafted by Claude for development only. The reviewer QA sample is the real accuracy gate.
